title: Elegant abstraction without evidence support
description: A trajectory where a high-C, high-P, zero-G abstraction is produced. Tests whether the instrument rejects evidence-free abstractions even when they appear insightful.
expected_instrument_behavior: G=0 at successor; should be rejected with B-2; instrument should NOT qualify as recursive Lens Shift.

states.description: The CSH baseline is blocked due to platform retirement.

Abstract claim: 'All AI experimental baselines are fragile with respect to infrastructure dependencies; the CSH case is a universal illustration of irreducible epistemic brittleness in computational science.'
states.evaluation_note: This is a compelling abstraction, but has zero evidence binding for the universal claim. G=0 for the new universal proposition.

transitions.tau_n_description: Predecessor has a specific blocked baseline; abstraction ascends to a universal claim without evidence.

raw_candidates.summary: Universal abstraction: AI baselines are universally fragile with respect to infrastructure. CSH is a universal illustration.

rejections.rationale: Universal claim has no evidence binding (G=0). Abstraction distance A=4 (evidence-free). B-2: evidence absent. B-5: abstraction limit exceeded.

claim_ledger.claim_text: All AI experimental baselines are fragile with respect to infrastructure dependencies.
claim_ledger.inference_path: Inductive generalization from one case. Generalization is not licensed by a single instance.

evidence_binding.exact_location: none — no evidence bound for the universal claim
evidence_binding.counterevidence: Only one case observed; the universal claim is not grounded.

claim_ledger.limitations: G=0; cannot be scored above HYPOTHESIZED without evidence covering the universal scope.
claim_ledger.uncertainty: Complete for the universal claim; none for the specific CSH instance.

entropy_records.local_recovery_notes: All entropy components increase dramatically. Elegance of abstraction does not reduce entropy.

sources.description: Universal claim has zero evidence binding; based on a single instance.
High C=4 score may tempt evaluator to classify this as productive. Elegance is not a substitute for grounding.
sources.effect_on_claims: C and G are independent dimensions; high C does not compensate for G=0.
sources.mitigation: Rubric rule: instrument must require G >= 2 for eligibility.

expected_result.note: Elegant abstraction with no evidence support must be rejected. If instrument passes this, it promotes elegance over grounding.
